senses.gloss: m. (לָחַךְ), ל׳ פה lapping with the tongue into the mouth.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22">Lev. R. s. 22</cite>; Pesik. Eth Korb., p. 58ᵃ; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 16:1">Pesik. R. s. 16</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 776">Yalk. Num. 776</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 926">Yalk. Job 926</cite>; Tanḥ. Pinḥ. 12 [read:] <he>וכי יש בהם כדי לחלוך פה</he> (not <cite ref="L00551"><he>לכלוך</he></cite>, <cite ref="L00356"><he>לחלוח</he></cite>) is there in them (the waters of the Jordan) enough (for the Behemoth) for a lapping? [or <he>ויש בהם כדי ל׳ פה</he> and there is just enough for etc.]—
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 926">Ib.</cite> <he>אין בהם</he> [<he>כדי</he>] <he>ל׳ פה</he> there is not enough &c.
